meta.name: learn
meta.description: Distill a reusable skill from anything — a directory, a URL, pasted notes, or what you just did together — or refine an existing skill with new learnings. Use when the user says '/learn', 'learn this', 'turn this into a skill', 'capture this workflow', 'make a skill from <source>', or 'improve/update the <name> skill'. Produces or updates a .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md authored to NanoClaw's skill guidelines. (This CREATES or REFINES a skill from a source; it does not install existing skills from a registry.)

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从任何来源提炼或改进可复用的技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要把操作流程固化为可复用的技能
copy.tagline_en: Distill or refine a reusable skill from any source
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to turn workflows into reusable skills

howto.what: 把目录、网址、粘贴的笔记或刚才完成的对话,提炼成可复用的技能文件(写入 .claude/skills/<名字>/SKILL.md);若已有同名技能,则原地更新并去重。
howto.when: 当你说“/learn”、要求“把这个变成技能”、说“学我们刚才做的”,或要求改进/更新某个技能时触发。

say.text: /learn 这个文件夹,把工作方式变成技能
say.note: 它会读取目录并生成 SKILL.md。
会把对话里的流程提炼成可复用技能。

say.text: /learn 这个网址,做成使用教程技能
say.note: 抓取页面并整理成技能说明。

howto.what_en: Turns a directory, URL, pasted notes, or the current conversation into a reusable skill file at .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md; updates an existing skill in place with deduplication.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say /learn, ask to turn something into a skill, refer to what we just did, or ask to improve/update an existing skill.

say_en.text: /learn this folder and turn how we work into a skill
say_en.note: It reads the directory and writes a SKILL.md.
It distills the workflow from the conversation.

say_en.text: /learn this URL as a usage skill
say_en.note: It fetches the page and builds a skill doc.
